```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  out_dir = "results",
  pkgs = c("base", "rmarkdown", "knitr",
           "readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "tibble", "stringr",
           "nlme", "lme4", "lmerTest", "ordinal", "vegan",
           "ggplot2", "patchwork", "scales", "ggbeeswarm", "ggtext")
)
dir.create(CFG$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r check}
missing <- setdiff(CFG$pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing)) stop("Not installed: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r citations}
pkg_version <- function(p) {
  if (p == "base") R.version.string else paste(p, packageVersion(p))
}

# Plain text
txt <- unlist(lapply(CFG$pkgs, function(p) {
  head <- pkg_version(p)
  c(head, strrep("-", nchar(head)),
    paste0(format(citation(p), style = "text"), "\n"), "")
}))
writeLines(c(paste("Generated", Sys.Date()), "", txt),
           file.path(CFG$out_dir, "citations.txt"))

# BibTeX
bib <- unlist(lapply(CFG$pkgs, function(p) {
  b <- as.character(toBibtex(citation(p)))
  starts <- grep("^@", b)
  key <- if (length(starts) > 1) paste0(p, seq_along(starts)) else p
  b[starts] <- paste0(sub("\\{.*$", "", b[starts]), "{", key, ",")
  c(b, "")
}))
writeLines(bib, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "citations.bib"))
```

```{r show, comment = ""}
cat(readLines(file.path(CFG$out_dir, "citations.txt")), sep = "\n")
```
